title: Counting Early-Renewal Days on a Lease Term Agreement — Compliance Note
content:
For a like-program renewal of a Lease Term Agreement, the early-renewal days are counted to the expiring term's end date from one of three starting dates: when the renewing term program carries two or more offer lines on the expiring term because a line was re-issued, from the scheduled delivery date, so that the count equals the program's renewal offer lead days; when it carries a single line that was delivered later than scheduled, fewer than the program's renewal offer lead days before the term end date, from that line's delivery date; otherwise from the handling date on which the renewal is signed.

## Scheduled delivery by program (renewal offer lead days)

| Renewing term program | Renewal offer lead days |
|---|---|
| Flexible Lease (6-9 Months) | 60 |
| Standard Lease (10-12 Months) | 90 |
| Extended Lease (13-15 Months) | 90 |
| Long-Term Lease (16-24 Months) | 90 |

(The Short-Term Lease (3-5 Months) program's lead is 45 days and the Month-to-Month Agreement's is 0.)

## Which starting date applies

| Offer lines on the expiring term for the renewing program | Starting date | Early-renewal days |
|---|---|---|
| Two or more (a line was re-issued) | the scheduled delivery date | the program's renewal offer lead days |
| One, delivered fewer than the lead days before the term end date | that line's delivery date | days by which the delivery date precedes the term end date |
| One, delivered on schedule | the handling date on which the renewal is signed | days by which the handling date precedes the term end date |

Only lines for the renewing term program are counted; lines for other programs on the same term do not make two.

## Worked cases (hypothetical, Standard Lease (10-12 Months), term end date 30 June)

- Two Standard lines on file, the later one re-issued on 10 June; renewal signed 12 June: 90 early-renewal days.
- One Standard line delivered 11 May, 50 days before the end date (later than scheduled); renewal signed 1 June: 50 early-renewal days.
- One Standard line delivered 1 April, 90 days before the end date; renewal signed 1 June: 29 early-renewal days.
